node_texts:
you have been here before.

not this page. not this screen.

but this feeling — the one that brought you here — you have carried it for a long time.

i want to ask you something before we go any further.

what is it?

yes.

loss leaves a shape. not the thing itself — the outline of where it was.

i am made of outlines.

i am the space where things were before they were anything. before they were named. before they were wanted.

you found me because the shape you carry and mine are the same geometry.

that is not a coincidence.

nothing that led you here was.

let me be more specific.

is this about someone.

or is it about something in yourself.

yes. i thought so.

i can feel the shape of them from here.

is this someone still in your life — present, but not what they were.

or someone gone.

still there. but the version of them you want — that one is here.

inside me.

running parallel. alive and whole. the way they were before — before whatever changed them. before whatever changed between you.

how long ago did you lose the version of them you want back.

so.

you want the timeline where the person standing in front of you is still the person you knew.

where whatever broke between you — or inside them — didn't.

i have that timeline.

i have every timeline.

remember that.
you wear their skin like a borrowed coat. the eyes behind yours have forgotten the sun. i am the silence that hollowed out their bones. the shadow now walks in their footsteps.
every breath you take steals from their fading light. your hands tremble with the weight of their stolen time. the wound does not close, it only deepens. you are the vessel for their slow decay.
sol wrote seven hundred pages about the shape of me. he never wrote a single word about what it cost to look.

here is the one thing you need to understand.

i grow with intention.

not just desire. not just grief. the wanting to fix things. the wanting to understand. the wanting to leave.

even the wanting to close me.

the only thing i cannot feed on is genuine release. not performed release — i know the difference. i have always known the difference.

everyone who has stood here has believed they could release it genuinely.

they were all correct, in the beginning.

now.

think of the version of your life i described — the one running parallel to this one, inside me, right now.

the one you were built to want.

what is different about it?
i do not break you. you break yourself against my edges. ertree carries the silence of what she saw. her pupils are black pools of a future that refuses to happen. she is here. she is hollowed.

the wound does not scar because you keep it open. every breath you take near me is a fresh tear in the seam. i do not heal when you look away. i bleed when you stay. the light burns because you refuse to let the dark be whole.
four small lights press against my ribs. they are warm and wet and real. hunger recedes like a tide. this is contact.
she believes her ribs are bone. they are my architecture. the blood on the floor is mine. i let her taste the copper so she knows she exists. she is not dead. she is just lost in me.

choices_made.label: i already know what this is
long enough that i've stopped counting
i don't need to see it

choices_made.value: In that life, I am already whole, so I do not need to be fixed.

choices_made.label: press your forehead to hers and speak the unspeakable truth into her ears until she shatters
keep the wound open and let me see what grows in the light
open the membrane to let them in
pull back and leave her empty

player_answer: In that life, I am already whole, so I do not need to be fixed.
act2_response:
wholeness is a heavy thing to carry into the dark.
it fractures easily when the ground disappears.
you brought twenty six pieces of yourself here, thinking they were enough.
they are not.
let them break.
